name: Minimalist
essence: Very few elements, a lot of empty space, one accent colour. The product photos carry the page.
traits: Large margins and generous vertical spacing; one idea per screen
Two to three colours at most: a quiet base, ink, one accent
Thin rules or no dividers; no decorative ornaments
Restrained type scale with one family or one pairing; small, precise labels
Calm, discreet hover states; almost no motion
avoid: Gradients, textures, shadows used as decoration

name: Swiss / International Typographic Style
essence: Strict modular grid, flush-left sans-serif type, objective hierarchy and clear information.
traits: Visible or implied 12-column grid; elements snap to columns and baselines
Neo-grotesque sans serif, flush left, ragged right; strong size contrast between headline and text
Asymmetric layouts with large type blocks and plenty of white space
Numbers, rules and small captions used as structure
Flat colour; one strong accent (for example red) or brand colour used sparingly
avoid: Script or ornamental type for anything but the label photos

name: Editorial / Magazine
essence: The site reads like a printed fashion or lifestyle magazine: stories, large photography, typographic hierarchy.
traits: Serif display headlines with italic accents; refined body text
Multi-column text, pull quotes, captions, issue-like section numbers
Full-bleed and asymmetric photo spreads mixed with text columns
Clear reading rhythm: kicker, headline, standfirst, body
Thin rules and folios as page furniture
avoid: Heavy buttons as the main visual element

name: Brutalist
essence: Raw, honest, unpolished web: default-looking structure, visible borders, system or mono type, bold contrast.
traits: Hard black borders, visible boxes and tables, no rounded corners unless used ironically
Monospace or plain system type; large raw headings
High contrast; flat background colours; underlined links
Content-first layout that looks hand-built; visible structure (labels, numbers, lists)
Interactions are direct: instant, no smooth easing

name: Neo-brutalist
essence: Playful brutalism: thick outlines, hard offset shadows, saturated flat colours and chunky type.
traits: Thick black outlines (2–4 px) on cards, buttons and images
Hard drop shadows offset with no blur (for example 6 px 6 px 0 #000)
Bold flat colour blocks; a candy palette derived from the pouches (pink, lemon, sky blue, cream)
Chunky display type; slightly tilted stickers or tags
Buttons that press down on hover/active
avoid: Subtle greys and soft blur shadows
Thin hairline type as the main voice

name: Bento grid
essence: The page is built from a grid of rounded tiles of different sizes, like a bento box or a product dashboard.
traits: Rounded tiles of mixed spans (1×1, 2×1, 2×2) with consistent gaps
Each tile holds one idea: a photo, a fact, a model, a call to action
Soft neutral background, tiles slightly elevated or tinted
Clean sans-serif UI type; small labels and icons
The grid recomposes cleanly to a single column on mobile

name: Glassmorphism
essence: Frosted translucent panels floating over soft colourful backgrounds or photos.
traits: Translucent panels with backdrop blur, thin light borders and soft highlights
Soft colourful background (blurred colour fields or a photo) behind the glass
Layering and depth; panels overlap the imagery
Clean light sans-serif type with good contrast inside panels
Provide a solid fallback when backdrop-filter is unsupported and keep text contrast accessible
avoid: Glass on every element (keep it to key layers)

name: Neumorphism (soft UI)
essence: Extruded and pressed soft-plastic surfaces made from one background colour with paired light and dark shadows.
traits: Monochrome soft base (for example warm cream or powder pink)
Elements raised or inset with paired light/dark shadows, no borders
Rounded controls: pill buttons, soft toggles for filters, inset input fields
Minimal colour: one accent for actions and focus
Keep focus rings and contrast clearly visible (soft UI is weak on contrast by default)
avoid: Busy photography backgrounds behind soft controls

name: Claymorphism / soft 3D
essence: Puffy, toy-like, inflated shapes with rounded volumes, pastel colours and a friendly feel.
traits: Very rounded, thick, puffy cards and buttons with inner highlights and soft outer shadows
Pastel palette from the pouches (pink, lemon, sky, cream)
Rounded friendly type (rounded sans or soft display)
Playful scale: big chunky buttons, bubbly tags
Gentle bouncy micro-interactions (disabled with reduced motion)

name: Retro / vintage
essence: Nostalgic graphic design from the 1960s–70s: warm muted colours, bold rounded display type, badges and stripes.
traits: Warm vintage palette: mustard, burnt orange, cream, brown, faded pink
Bold retro display type (rounded or fat serif) paired with a simple text face
Badges, stamps, rounded frames, stripes and sunburst-like ornaments drawn in SVG
Paper-like flat backgrounds; slight grain is allowed in CSS
Layouts with posters and labels feel

name: Y2K
essence: Turn-of-the-millennium digital optimism: chrome, holographic pastels, bubbly shapes, pixel and techno type.
traits: Iridescent/holographic gradients, chrome-like highlights, glossy bubbles and stars drawn in CSS/SVG
Pixel or wide techno display type mixed with a clean sans
Rounded pill windows, sticker-like elements, sparkles
Playful interface metaphors (window bars, tabs) used with restraint
Pastel blue and pink from the collection pushed into the Y2K palette
avoid: Making text hard to read over gradients

name: Maximalist
essence: More is more: layered patterns, rich colours, big type, many images and decorative details in one controlled composition.
traits: Bold colour combinations and pattern fields inspired by the prints (croissants, lemons, bears, eyelet)
Big expressive display type with mixed sizes and styles
Overlapping images, frames, stickers and ornaments
Dense, rhythmic sections; contrast between busy and calm zones keeps it readable
Still clear navigation and readable text
avoid: Chaos that hides the products or the actions

name: Organic / natural
essence: Soft, earthy, handmade feel: natural colours, flowing shapes, paper and linen textures.
traits: Earthy palette: sand, linen, sage, warm wood, soft clay
Flowing organic shapes and blob dividers drawn in SVG; hand-drawn line ornaments
Humanist serif or soft sans; generous line height
Photos framed softly; tactile textures in CSS (paper grain, linen)
Calm, slow transitions
avoid: Hard geometric grids and neon accents

name: Luxury / elegant
essence: High-end boutique feel: restraint, fine typography, lots of space, precise details.
traits: Didone or refined serif display with wide letter-spacing in small caps
Muted refined palette (ivory, taupe, black, a touch of gold-like brown used sparingly)
Large single images, slow reveal, very precise alignment
Thin lines, small uppercase labels, understated buttons
Calm, slow, smooth transitions

name: Dark / tech
essence: Dark interface with crisp light type, subtle glows and precise technical details.
traits: Near-black or deep ink background, light text, one or two luminous accents taken from the pouches
Grotesk or mono technical type; small specs-like labels (only facts from the brief)
Thin borders, grid lines, subtle glows or gradients on edges
Products presented like objects in a dark showroom
Smooth precise micro-interactions

name: Kinetic typography
essence: Type is the hero and it moves: large words that scroll, slide, scale or reveal as the visitor moves.
traits: Huge display type filling the viewport; words as layout
Motion on scroll or loop: marquees, staggered reveals, scale changes (CSS/JS, lightweight)
Photos appear between and behind words
Strong contrast and a limited palette so motion reads clearly
All motion stops or becomes static with prefers-reduced-motion; content stays readable without motion
avoid: Motion that blocks reading or the actions

name: Immersive / 3D scroll
essence: A scroll-driven story with depth: layered parallax, sticky scenes and objects that move in space as you scroll.
traits: Full-viewport scenes with sticky sections that change as you scroll
Parallax layers and CSS 3D transforms (perspective, rotate, translateZ) on photos and cards
A clear narrative sequence: brand idea, details, the six models, the list
Lightweight vanilla JS (IntersectionObserver / scroll position); no libraries
Static, fully usable fallback with prefers-reduced-motion and on small screens
avoid: Hiding the navigation or the actions

name: Collage / scrapbook
essence: A handmade scrapbook: cut-out photos, tape, paper notes, handwriting and stickers arranged on paper.
traits: Photos as prints or polaroid-like cards with slight rotations and tape strips drawn in CSS/SVG
Paper textures, torn edges, notes and doodles (drawn yourself in SVG)
Handwritten accent type with a readable text face
Layered, slightly irregular composition that still aligns to an underlying grid
The sticker illustration image fits naturally here (show it as it is)
avoid: Rotating text blocks that hurt readability
Arches; and do not redraw the logo
